prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: the paper screen; stacked documents.
Opens on the paper screen, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the screen tilts back and stacked documents feed into it, settling in a neat pile.
Ends holding on the document pile.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "ESG DATA".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "ESG DATA". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report climate data.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Stop-motion editorial paper collage style, Static Shot. The scene opens anchored on <Picture 1>, showing a flat, soft violet paper background, a central halftone cutout of a blank computer screen with torn white edges, and an upper headline chip under soft upper-left lighting. A narrator (S1, warm, clear, articulate, brisk) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report climate data.</d> At the first frame, the initial paper banner slides rapidly off the left edge. A fresh cream paper chip drops cleanly into the upper third with a slight overshoot and settles, displaying crisp black text reading "ESG DATA". Concurrently, the central paper screen cutout tilts slightly backward as blank, unmarked document cutouts feed into it in rapid succession, stacking neatly on the cream mat below. The composition holds cleanly on the stacked documents through the final seconds with faint paper micro-settling.

overall_soundscape: Crisp paper swishes and light friction sounds as the top banner slides out, followed by a soft paper-slap upon the new headline landing and rhythmic paper rustles as the documents stack.
